premises: A yield strength plateau exists in NbTaHfTiZrV0.5 between ~673 K and 1073 K
Edge dislocations are prevalent and dominant in this alloy, contrary to typical BCC behavior
Thermal super-jogging on edge dislocations provides a temperature-insensitive barrier to motion
Screw dislocation motion via double-kink nucleation cannot explain the retained strength
The plateau is distinct from diffusion-controlled softening above ~1073 K
